normalized.description: This Market Consultation serves to prepare for the proposed call for tenders to procure the supply of radar sensors. These sensors will replace the current sensors in two areas of application: the Wadden sea and the channel connecting Amsterdam with the Rhine (Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal). Rijkswaterstaat, the Public Works Department and Water Management attaches great importance to the opinions of market parties and wants to involve them early and actively before the proposed call for tenders starts. On the Wadden islands and along the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal there are several radar sensors which are used for vessel traffic management purposes. The sensors on the Wadden islands are being used to monitor marine traffic on the Wadden sea. The radar sensors along the Amsterdam-Rijn channel are used by the traffic management post in Wijk bij Duurstede. These traffic management posts safeguard and manage shipping traffic in the Wadden area and the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal. The images from the sensors at Terschelling and Schiermonnikoog are also used by the Dutch coast guard for executing Search and Rescue (SAR) and law enforcement activities. The goal of this project is the purchase of several nautical sensors to replace the exist-ing end-of-life sensors.
